question: If x = 7 - 4sqrt{3} , then find the value of ( x² + (1)/(x²) ).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x = a − √b and a² − b = 1, then 1/x = a + √b.

Here, 7² − (4√3)² = 49 − 48 = 1, so 1/x = 7 + 4√3.

⇒ x + 1/x = (7 − 4√3) + (7 + 4√3) = 14

⇒ x² + 1/x² = k² − 2 = 14² − 2 = 196 − 2 = 194

**∴ The correct answer is 194.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 7 − 4√3

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1/x = 1 / (7 − 4√3)

⇒ Rationalizing the denominator by multiplying the numerator and denominator by (7 + 4√3):

⇒ 1/x = (7 + 4√3) / [(7 − 4√3)(7 + 4√3)]

⇒ 1/x = (7 + 4√3) / (7² − (4√3)²)

⇒ 1/x = (7 + 4√3) / (49 − 48)

⇒ 1/x = 7 + 4√3

⇒ Now, x + 1/x = (7 − 4√3) + (7 + 4√3)

⇒ x + 1/x = 14

⇒ Squaring both sides:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 14²

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2(x)(1/x) = 196

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 196

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 196 − 2 = 194

**∴ The correct answer is 194.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rationalization Concept

If the difference between the squares of two terms in a binomial surd is 1, then its reciprocal is simply its conjugate. For example, if a = √p + √q and p − q = 1, then 1/a = √p − √q.

Important Algebraic Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Higher Power Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. Also, x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (k² − 2)² − 2.
